## Declarations and implementations

```plato

    //==
    // # Trigonometry over the radians kernel
    //
    // Sin, Cos and Atan2Radians are the kernel. The hyperbolics come from Exp
    // and the inverse family from Atan2Radians and NaturalLog.

    // The tangent of an angle in radians.
    Tan(self: Number): Number
        => self.Sin / self.Cos;

    // The hyperbolic sine. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyperbolic_functions)
    Sinh(self: Number): Number
        => (self.Exp - (-self).Exp) / 2.0;

    // The hyperbolic cosine.
    Cosh(self: Number): Number
        => (self.Exp + (-self).Exp) / 2.0;

    // The hyperbolic tangent.
    Tanh(self: Number): Number
        => self.Sinh / self.Cosh;

    // The arccosine in radians: atan2(sqrt(1 - x^2), x). Precondition: |x| <= 1.
    AcosRadians(self: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - self * self).Sqrt.Atan2Radians(self);

    // The arcsine in radians: atan2(x, sqrt(1 - x^2)). Precondition: |x| <= 1.
    AsinRadians(self: Number): Number
        => self.Atan2Radians((1.0 - self * self).Sqrt);

    // The arctangent in radians: atan2(x, 1).
    AtanRadians(self: Number): Number
        => self.Atan2Radians(1.0);

    // The inverse hyperbolic cosine. Precondition: x >= 1.
    AcoshRadians(self: Number): Number
        => (self + (self * self - 1.0).Sqrt).NaturalLog;

    // The inverse hyperbolic sine, defined for every real x.
    AsinhRadians(self: Number): Number
        => (self + (self * self + 1.0).Sqrt).NaturalLog;

    // The inverse hyperbolic tangent. Precondition: |x| < 1.
    AtanhRadians(self: Number): Number
        => ((1.0 + self) / (1.0 - self)).NaturalLog * 0.5;

    //==
    // # Constants and classification
    //
    // Pi is the kernel constant; the other two are formulas over it and Exp.
    // Dispatch on an ignored receiver, the tree's constant idiom.

    // The additive identity.
    Zero(_: Number): Number
        => 0.0;

    // The multiplicative identity.
    One(_: Number): Number
        => 1.0;

    // The circle constant, two pi. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turn_(angle))
    Tau(_: Number): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi;

    // Euler's number, the base of the natural logarithm.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E_(mathematical_constant))
    E(_: Number): Number
        => 1.0.Exp;

    // True when the value is an ordinary finite number: neither NaN nor an
    // infinity.
    IsFinite(self: Number): Boolean
        => !self.IsNaN && !self.IsInfinite;
}
```
